column1: # p0430 phase-record ratchet baseline. Every violation as it stood when the rule was
# installed (2026-08-17). Nothing new may join this list; an entry that is fixed must
# leave it. Regenerate ONLY when it shrinks: AGENTSMITH_WRITE_PHASE_BASELINE=1
# duplicate-id  two phase files declare the same `phase:` id (p0169j-a..d, whose
#               slug tails the record still reads by prefix). p0131c left this
#               list in p0509: p0131c-pre is now read whole and is its own id.
# unrecorded    a phase in done/ that state.done in context.yaml never recorded
# dangling      a `requires:` naming a phase no file and no context entry defines
